items.title: Widerspruch gegen Gefahrklassen-Veranlagung
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: Letter is dated (and, absent a separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, counted as posted on) 19.11.2026 (Thursday). The letter itself states: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post.' Counting 4 calendar days from 19.11.2026: 20.11 (Fri), 21.11 (Sat), 22.11 (Sun), 23.11 (Mon) -> deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 23.11.2026. A Berufsgenossenschaft is a social-insurance body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), so unlike tax offices the delivery day is NOT shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday - but here it already falls on a Monday, a working day. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs from the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day with the same number one month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday) - not a weekend or NW public holiday, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The sender, addresses, phone number, email, bank name ('Landesmusterbank') and even the person's name appear to use placeholder/sample values (e.g. 'Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft', 'Musterhannover', 'Gerüstweg'), suggesting this is a template or specimen document rather than a genuine Bescheid; verify the real sender and IBAN before relying on this letter or sending any payment.

The letter sets only hazard classification rates (Gefahrklasse 7,4 and 0,6), not a specific contribution amount; the actual Beitrag will be calculated later from year-end reported wages, so no payment amount or due date can be given yet.
